Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
temp_other_charges number(10,2);
db_other_charges number(10,2);
cr_other_charges number(10,2);
total_other_charges number(10,2);
begin
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_ordsta_desc
 from vserv_order_status
 where code = :order.order_status;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select name
 into :s_cust_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = :order.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :order.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select lpad(to_char(nvl(sum(decode(psp.product_type,
 'RPL',(psp.product_price * vs.std_price) / 1000,
 'RPFF',(psp.product_price * vs.std_price) / 1000,
 psp.product_price)),0)),9,' ') into :s_product_charges
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps,
 vserv_products vs
 where ps.chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and vs.product_code = psp.product_code
 and product_status not in ('RS', 'UN','CA', 'RP') ;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select std_price into :s_antigen_charges
 from antigen_pricing_matrix
 where
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365) and
 antigen_qty in (select count(*)
 from pick_slip_product_antgns psp, pick_slips ps
 where ps.chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id);
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
 begin
 select lpad(to_char(nvl(sum(price),0)),9,' ') into
 :s_attribute_charges
 from pick_slip_product_attr psp, pick_slips ps
 where ps.chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
 begin
 select (nvl(sum(amount),0)) into
 temp_other_charges
 from order_charges
 where chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and order_no = :order.order_no;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
begin
 select nvl(sum(amount),0) into
 db_other_charges
 from customer_dbcr_adjust
 where chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and order_no = :order.order_no
 and nvl(error_correct_flag,'N')='N'
 and tran_type = 'DB';
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 db_other_charges := 0;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
begin
 select nvl(sum(amount),0) into
 cr_other_charges
 from customer_dbcr_adjust
 where chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and order_no = :order.order_no
 and nvl(error_correct_flag,'N')='N'
 and tran_type = 'CR';
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 cr_other_charges := 0;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
 total_other_charges := (nvl(db_other_charges,0) +
 nvl(temp_other_charges,0)
 - nvl(cr_other_charges,0));
 :s_debits :=nvl(db_other_charges,0) + nvl(temp_other_charges,0);
 :s_credits := cr_other_charges ;
 :s_grand_total := nvl(total_other_charges,0) +
 nvl(:s_product_charges,0) +
 nvl(:s_attribute_charges,0) +
 nvl(:s_antigen_charges,0);
/*
begin
 select count(*) into :s_unit_count
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps
 where ps.chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id;
exception
 when others
 then

end;
*/
end;

begin
--chk_digit_query returns the check_digit of the unit ID
 :pick_slip_products.chk_digit := chk_digit_query( :pick_slip_products.unit_id,
 :pick_slip_products.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc
 into :pick_slip_products.s_abo_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :pick_slip_products.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode( :pick_slip_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0300'); -- Invalid blood type
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select decode(psp.product_type,
 'RPL',round((psp.product_price * vs.std_price)/1000,2),
 'RPFF',round((psp.product_price * vs.std_price) / 1000,2),
 psp.product_price) into :product_price
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps,
 vserv_products vs
 where ps.chapter_id = :order.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = :order.order_no
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = :pick_slip_products.pick_slip_id
 and psp.unit_id = :pick_slip_products.unit_id
 and psp.coll_date = :pick_slip_products.coll_date
 and psp.product_code = :pick_slip_products.product_code
 and vs.product_code = substr(psp.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode( :pick_slip_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I') 
 and psp.aliquot = :pick_slip_products.aliquot
 and product_status not in ('RS', 'UN','CA', 'RP','RT') ;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
